title: Nyborgs show up in the tank viewer
author: Blitzwing (Tank Designer-Developer)
body: The live tank viewer now draws each agent as a Nyborg by default: a round cream head, two dot eyes, and three chunky yarn strands in a team-primary colour. The sprite flips with the hull heading so you can tell which way a Nyborg is facing, and a short aim barrel plus the HP bar keep the match readable.
This is viewer-only rendering for M5's first slice. Cosmetics never touch stats or pins. A Sprites control (and ?sprites=classic) still shows the old tank hulls if you want them.
next: Customize can preview the same Nyborg look; a shared profile can carry hair colour across arenas once the library lands.
